messages:
RecruiterEmma: Morning team — we've got a candidate for SRE who prefers APAC-friendly hours. Target panel window: Thu 2024-06-12 21:00–22:30 UTC. Can someone cover interviewer + scribe + debrief owner? Also small rubric tweak request: prioritize incident diagnosis over runbook recall (we'll shift weights). Calendar link: https://cal.redwood/slots

Alex: I can do interviewer but heads-up that's late for me (2am local). :yawning_face: I'm fine if recording is transcript-only. Who's debrief owner?

Samir: I can scribe and capture timestamps + leaderboard notes. Agree on weight shift — I'll draft the short anchor examples in the rubric doc. @Priya want to OK calibration?

Priya: OK to shift weights. Please add a 1–2 line anchor per rubric item so other interviewers know what qualifies as "strong" vs "weak".

Alex: Quick flow question — candidate already completed the take-home. Recommend we skip live coding: 20-min system-design prompt + 10-min follow-ups and cultural fit. Less flaky at 2am.

RecruiterEmma: Sounds good, we'll do design + Qs. Samir, can you paste the rubric snippet here after you update it? Also reminder to get candidate consent for recording/transcript before the panel.

Samir: Sure — updated snippet below and added to rubric doc. Also added meeting note to invite with consent checkbox.

```
Incident diagnosis (0-5): 0 = no structured approach; 3 = finds likely root cause but misses some context; 5 = systematic isolation, suggests mitigations with tradeoffs
Runbook familiarity (0-3): 0 = no use; 1 = partial; 3 = clear application and explains when to update runbook
Communication (0-2): 0 = unclear; 1 = adequate; 2 = concise and context-aware
```

Samir: Calendar invite updated (scribe = Samir, interviewer = Alex, debrief owner = Alex). Invite link: https://cal.redwood/meeting/abc123

RecruiterEmma: Thanks — Alex if you need a swap, ping here and we'll reassign. Samir, please post one-line takeaways in the debrief thread within 30 min after interview.

Alex: Will do. Added a tiny checklist in invite notes: KMS consent recorded, transcript only, no sharing of take-home code beyond evaluation scope.

RecruiterEmma: Friendly reminder to complete the quick rubric calibration form by EOD Wed (link in the invite). :eyes:

PeopleOpsBot: Reminder: panel commitment recorded for thread 1745550123 (participants: RecruiterEmma, Alex, Samir, Priya).
